title: Architecture Trade-offs
description: Evaluate real-world architecture decisions through structured trade-off analysis. Each problem presents competing approaches and asks you to justify the right choice for a given context.
longDescription: Master architecture decision-making through ten realistic problems. Compare modular monoliths against microservices, evaluate API styles, choose data stores for specific workload patterns, and decide when a distributed workflow needs orchestration versus choreography. Each lesson provides structured trade-off analysis, recommended solutions, and the reasoning behind them.
